_comment: Review-tier bars enforced by review_gate.check(). A tier maps to the minimum bar a PASSING attestation must clear: verdict, ceiling on confirmed findings, and (optionally) an allow-list of review_verdict strings. Override the path with env REVIEW_TIERS. See review_gate.py.
_lens_comment: required_lenses: the reviewing passes a review result must DECLARE (each as a distinct run) for a full-pass attestation at this tier. Enforced by review_gate.check_lens_coverage — a findings[] list alone does not prove the review's breadth (a 3-lens and a 6-lens pass produce the same shape), so lens coverage is now checked in code, not left to prose. Names are the reviewer's lens labels; edit the sets freely per your process. Empty = no lens requirement.
